description: This file declares the MediaMuxer class used for multiplexing multiple media tracks into a video file, supporting formats like mp4, webm, and ogg. It includes methods for adding tracks, starting/stopping muxing, setting orientation and location, and writing sample data.

classes.name: MediaMuxer
classes.description: A class for multiplexing multiple media tracks into a single output file, supporting formats like mp4, webm, and ogg.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a MediaMuxer instance for a given output format and file descriptor.

methods.name: addTrack
methods.description: Adds a media track with its format information before starting muxing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the muxing process after all tracks are added.

methods.name: setOrientationHint
methods.description: Sets the rotation degrees for the output video.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the geographic location metadata for the output.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the muxing process, blocking until completion.

methods.name: writeSampleData
methods.description: Feeds sample buffers into the muxer for encoding.

methods.name: getTrackCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tracks added successfully.

methods.name: getTrackFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the format information for a specific track.
